content: Root cause: The bug was caused by memory leaks and use-after-free errors occurring during the probe and remove processes of the driver due to improper handling of device registrations and memory allocations. Specifically, when errors occurred after allocating devices, the driver failed to properly free the allocated memory and deregister the devices, leading to memory not being released, as well as scenarios where the devices were accessed after being freed. The patch corrects these issues by ensuring that all allocated resources are properly cleaned up in error paths and that dereferencing operations occur after ensuring the devices are still valid.
